commit.message:
feat(i18n): a catalogue crate with English as the source and fallback

Adds camcraft-i18n (#853): Lang, the "English source" = "translation"
catalogue reader, the lookup (tr, tr_in, count), the language switch
(set_lang, init_from_env reading CAMCRAFT_LANG as a BCP 47 tag) and the
coverage report. English is the key, so a miss is the English string and a
source rewording degrades to English; a malformed line is refused by line
number instead of skipped, and a catalogue that does not load leaves
English in force.

Ships assets/i18n/zh-CN.toml (467 pairs: ribbon, tree, tool kinds, machine
tabs, the shared property vocabulary), a translator guide that needs no
build, and scripts/i18n/check.py for the same checks without Rust.

Refs #853

feat(ui): a bundled CJK face and the language door

A translated language installs its font; English installs nothing, so the
English window keeps egui's own face and metrics (#853).

- assets/ui/fonts/NotoSansSC-Regular-Subset.ttf: Noto Sans SC 400, cut to
  ASCII, Latin-1, punctuation, fullwidth forms and the 6 763 GB2312 hanzi
  (8 090 code points, 2.3 MB) by scripts/fonts/subset_sc.py. OFL 1.1,
  licence beside it, notice in assets/ui/LICENSES.md.
- fonts.rs installs it first in Proportional (one face, one line height for
  Latin and hanzi in the same label) and last in Monospace.
- run() reads CAMCRAFT_LANG, reports the catalogue once, and the native and
  web shells install the face on their context.

Refs #853

feat(ui): translate at five seams, not at every call site

and an English session gets it back unchanged, so every existing
label-based test still holds.

- layout/form.rs: label_cell (every prop_row / check_row), group headers,
  action_bar verbs.
- browser_tree.rs: t_row for section headers and literal rows. User names
  (setups, models, tools) never pass through, so a name that matches a key
  never changes under the user; count() routes its unit through the
  catalogue for languages whose unit carries a classifier.
- panes.rs: ribbon captions (text_of), group captions, section dropdown
  rows, machine tabs.
- op_tabs.rs: the operation's section tabs.
- op_page.rs / geo_page.rs / machine_page.rs / browser_pane.rs: heading,
  type line, tool/setup/source/coolant rows, pick mode, WCS footer verbs,
  expand/collapse.

Refs #853

test(i18n): pin the font coverage, the translations and the layout

- fonts_tests.rs reads the bundled TTF's cmap directly (no font
  dependency): every glyph of every translated string exists, the unit
  signs are there too, English installs nothing, and Chinese measures its
  own glyphs rather than a fallback.
- i18n_tests.rs: every ribbon, tree and machine-tab string has a Chinese
  translation; the common property vocabulary is covered; every Chinese
  ribbon caption fits the cell; the translated set is narrower in aggregate
  than the English one.
- tests.rs: egui_shell_snapshot_chinese, the whole window in Chinese
  (release lane like its English twin), snapshot egui_app_zh.png.

Refs #853

docs(i18n): the design, the measurements and what is left

docs/I18N.md: the architecture, the five seams, the measured ribbon widths,
the font and its licence, the tests, and the remaining work (hints, status
line, app refusals with stable names, the persisted picker, panel titles,
locale number formatting, more languages).
docs/decisions/853-ui-translations.md: the decisions and what was dropped.

Refs #853

feat(i18n): follow the system language, and let the View door change it

Start in the system locale (LC_ALL, then LC_MESSAGES, then LANG) instead of
always English, and add the persisted picker #853 asked for: the View door's
Language list offers "Follow system", English and 简体中文, switches the whole
window at once and writes the pick to prefs.json beside the theme.

- camcraft-i18n: the language in force is a thread-local, so a unit test can
  switch languages without changing another test's labels; a stored preference
  is not applied when CAMCRAFT_LANG named one for the run.
- app::prefs: ViewPrefs.language, written only when pinned; a value that cannot
  be a BCP 47 tag is a status note, not an unreadable file.
- ui: State.language and select_language (set_lang + persist + status); the
  door's rows come from Lang::ALL, so a new language appears by existing, and
  each names itself in its own words - never translated.

Refs #853

fix(i18n): name a CAMCRAFT_LANG this build cannot read

An unknown tag used to fall through silently (and, before the picker, left
English). It now logs once and is ignored, so the stored preference - or the
system locale - decides as if the variable were unset. The entry comment and
docs say so.

Refs #853

fix(i18n): an English start never reads as a refused catalogue

`report` treated the source language's deliberate absence of a catalogue as
an error, so every English run logged "i18n: en catalogue refused: []" at
startup. The source now reports zero strings and the entry point says nothing
for it; a translated language still reports its size, or why it refused.

Refs #853
fix(i18n): keep operation-header translations after upstream refactor
fix(i18n): translate the Undercut and V-Carve operations

feat(i18n): extend zh-CN catalogue to 1026 strings and route UI text through tr()

- Wire hint(), consequence(), action_bar hints, auto toggles and status
  banner line through camcraft_i18n::tr(), covering all prop-row help
  and consequence text centrally.
- Wrap 653 static literals at egui text call sites (on_hover_text, label,
  button, checkbox, etc.) in 83+ UI source files.
- Add 447 missing strings plus 106 UI string constants to zh-CN.toml
  (473 -> 1026 keys) with Chinese translations.
- Wrap 37 string-constant call sites with tr().

Validation: cargo check -p camcraft-ui clean; camcraft-i18n 10/10 tests
pass; UI i18n gates 4/4 pass; font coverage 4/4 pass.
feat(i18n): translate dynamic UI text through tf() and extend catalogue to 1733 strings
feat(i18n): translate app-layer status and error messages
fix(i18n): translate UI labels drawn outside tr() helpers

feat(i18n): data-driven language registry and status-line translations

- Lang becomes a descriptor; one REGISTRY row describes each shipped
  language. ALL, tag parsing, the catalogue cache and the picker derive
  from it, so adding a language needs a catalogue file and a row, not a
  code change. A test pins registry consistency.
- Route 72 user-visible format! status/refusal/label call sites through
  tf(); translate the timed import line at its own seam.
- zh-CN.toml: 3567 -> 3636 entries, with placeholder checks on every
  new template.
- Update docs and the language-pick test for the translated status prefix.

Verification: i18n 12+1 doctest, UI i18n 4, fonts 4, full UI suite 1429
passed (3 environment-blocked tests skipped), cargo check --all-targets
clean, coverage scans 0 missing in ui and app.

fix(i18n): translate visible refusal heads without losing stable codes

- cutter/holder profile and tool-update refusals now show translated
  sentences through tf() instead of bare English prefixes.
- PROFILE_REFUSED stays an English stable code; matching accepts either
  the code or its current translation, with a regression test proving a
  translated refusal still retires and other Tool refusals stand.
- zh-CN.toml 3636 -> 3638; docs and report updated.

Verification: all-targets check clean; i18n 12+1, UI i18n 4, fonts 4,
profile refusals 3, cross-language refusal test 1 all pass.
